nota.t: Key words: present simple, present continuous, past simple, review.
Key words: 999, ambulance, fire engine, police, injured, rescue, while + past continuous.
Key words: used to, candle, radio, kampung, have/has + past participle.
have / has + past participle: I have finished my homework. She has visited Sabah.
Signal words: already, yet, ever, never, just, since, for.
Key words: explore, cave, jungle, map, compass, set off, look for, carry on.
Key words: astronaut, vet, engineer, chef, pilot, programmer, would like to be.
Key words: passport, luggage, ticket, departure, arrival, destination, map, app.

nota.t: Key words: is made of, is made from, is grown, factory, process, first, then, finally.
Active: The cat ate the fish. Passive: The fish was eaten by the cat. (be + past participle)
We use the passive when the action is more important than who did it: Rubber is grown in Malaysia.
Key words: guitar, drum, piano, violin, kompang, rebana, beat, rhythm, concert.
Key words: once upon a time, beginning, middle, end, character, setting, plot, said that.
Direct: Ali said, "I am hungry." Reported: Ali said (that) he was hungry. The tense often moves back one step.
You are ready, aren't you? She can swim, can't she? They didn't come, did they?
Key words: I think, In my opinion, I agree, I disagree, because, however.

t: Skim: read quickly for the main idea.
Scan: look for specific information (names, numbers, dates).
Use context clues to guess new words.
A paragraph has a topic sentence, supporting details and a concluding sentence.
An informal email/letter: greeting, body, closing.
Check spelling, punctuation and capital letters.

nota.t: Key words: mystery, clue, detective, footprints, might, could, must (be), can't (be).
